function calcMediaBox(naturalW, naturalH, boundW, boundH): object

Defined in: core/utils/wasm/wasm-layout.ts:326

Capped media box in px: natural dims multiplied by calcMediaScale — the largest box that both fits the bounds and never exceeds the source's natural size. Used to mirror the CSS min(--mf-, --mf-natural-) caps in JS projections (carousel fit measurement) so the side-by-side decision and the published slide heights match the rendered layout.
